items:
Perfect for Families with Newly Designed Nautical Bunkroom!

You and your family will LOVE this bright, airy beach house with a gulf view from the top deck! With 5 BR & 4 BA and a newly renovated Bunk Room perfect for the little ones, you will have plenty of space to stretch out and enjoy the public beach access within a 5 minute walk... or dip in the heated** play pool right at your beach house! 3 vehicles can comfortably park in the driveway, and free street parking is also available. Bike rental shops are blocks away, you can cycle on the miles upon miles of our State Park trails right next door. We invite you to come and relax at this awesome 30A gem!

**Pool heating is available for $35/night. Please contact us after you instant book to let us know you want the pool heated; we will send you a VRBO payment request and add a note to your reservation to heat the pool

Every bedroom has a TV with WiFi for streaming. Ceiling fans in all bedrooms except the bunkroom.

The main floor (2nd floor) is a bright, open concept living area where guests will not be hindered by walls separating the kitchen/dining/living room. The main floor offers one bedroom with a queen bed and lounge couch, a bathroom, and laundry room with washer/dryer. The main floor is your primary entryway..

The top floor has two bedrooms. The master has a king bed, balcony with a gulf view, and double vanity private bathroom. The other bedroom features a queen bed with it's own private bathroom.

The ground floor has two bedrooms. One king bedroom with pool access, a deck, private bathroom, and a small desk. The other bedroom is the converted and newly updated kids bunkroom. This vibrant and playful room is perfect for families with little ones. Designed to spark imagination, it features a whimsical boat-shaped bunk bed, complete with a steering wheel and safety netting. The lower bunk mimics a ship's cabin, ensuring a cozy retreat with two full beds. In addition, separate full over full bunk beds offer extra sleeping space. Plush bean bags provide a comfy spot for relaxation or playtime and includes a tv for entertainment.

Enjoy lounge chairs and a sizable deck to grill out and relax!

Our rules at a glance
Please read the rules section for a complete list -
NO SMOKING!
No Pets
No parties or loud music

We provide some basic house hold starter items to help get your trip started. Please note, for longer stays you may need to purchase additional supplies.

Check in is at 4PM

Check out is at 10AM (200$ fee for late checkouts due to increased time needed for extra cleanliness and sanitation practices.)
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

items:
Every bedroom has a TV with WiFi connectivity for streaming and cable hookups for local channels. Ceiling fans in all bedrooms. All bedrooms with the exception of the bunk room are offer gorgeous natural light to make the rooms bright and cheery. The Bunk Room is a converted garage with no windows however boasts high ceilings and adequate overhead lighting. Bunk room also has a sleep sofa for more sleeping room.
Ground Floor Nautical bedroom hosts the indoor access to the pool and deck, so there may be family traffic! Main Floor Beach Bedroom has a twin to king bridge in the closet if you prefer a King Bed. Each twin also has a pull out twin trundle bed for more sleeping capacity. Clean linens are provided. All bedrooms are large and roomy, making it for a comfortable stay.
